name: metricbraid
description: Evidence-aware routing for overlapping personal sensor data — decide which measurement an AI is allowed to believe, and record why.

plugins.name: metricbraid
plugins.description: After installing, reload plugins and run /metricbraid:metricbraid-init in your project. MetricBraid wires up Garmin and Oura and adds evidence-aware routing, deduplication, provenance and explicit conflict handling for overlapping personal sensor data.
